verdict.rationale: Convex calls itself a reactive database with real-time sync for building live-updating apps. Convex engineers explain that subscriptions track each query's readset and re-run it only when a committed write touches those dependencies, with no polling. An outside commenter praises this function-level reactivity model, and client support is listed for React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the client subscription API (e.g. how a UI component subscribes), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-authored explanations.
